changeSet.sql: update school_entry_procedure sep set first_eye_examination_or_hearing_test_modified_by = first_examination.triggered_by from ( select distinct on (pe.procedure_id) pe.procedure_id, spe.triggered_by from progress_entry pe join system_progress_entry spe on pe.id = spe.id where spe.system_progress_entry_type in ('EYE_EXAMINATION_MODIFIED', 'HEARING_TEST_MODIFIED') order by pe.procedure_id, pe.created_at ) first_examination WHERE sep.id = first_examination.procedure_id

update school_entry_procedure sep set first_school_info_letter_generated_by = first_info_letter.triggered_by from ( select distinct on (pe.procedure_id) pe.procedure_id, spe.triggered_by from progress_entry pe join system_progress_entry spe on pe.id = spe.id where spe.system_progress_entry_type = 'SCHOOL_INFO_LETTER_GENERATED' order by pe.procedure_id, pe.created_at ) first_info_letter WHERE sep.id = first_info_letter.procedure_id
